newsitem.title: USA: First Data up on Lehman buy comments.
newsitem.headline: First Data up on Lehman buy comments.

text.p: First Data Corp gained 1-3/4 to 37-1/4 in afternoon trading Tuesday after Lehman Brothers restated its buy rating due to strong corporate fundamentals.
Lehman analyst Patrick Burton also set a one-year share price target of $51 a share.
First Data, which provides cardholder services to financial institutions, remains on track to earn about $0.45 a share for the fourth quarter, Burton said.
Since hitting $43-13/16 on October 7, First Data had dropped about 19 percent to Monday's close of 35-1/2.

Burton suggested that First Data's stock price has been hurt by several factors, such as the recent slump in computer and information service stocks and investor confusion over the recent spinoff of MoneyGram Payment Systems Inc.
First Data spun off MoneyGram in a December 11 initial public offering.
Investors should buy during this temporary weakness in stock, Burton said.
